name: Intra-Candle Absorption & Volume Spike (Fixed)

conditions: close > open and volume >= avgVol * volSpikeMult and range > avgRange * absRangePct / 100
close < open and volume >= avgVol * volSpikeMult and range > avgRange * absRangePct / 100

notes: Intra-candle volume spike without price absorption; direction by candle close. avgVol / avgRange are lower-timeframe averages within the bar.
